US passport photo at home

Take a US passport photo with your phone for free. The camera guides you to the official 2×2 in (51×51 mm) format with a plain white or off-white background, checks the result, and never uploads your photo.

US passport photo rules

Photo size
2×2 in (51×51 mm)
Head height
25.4–34.9 mm, measured chin to top of head, not counting hair
Eye line
28.6–34.9 mm from the bottom of the photo
Background
Plain white or off-white
Glasses
Remove them (exceptions are rare, such as medical reasons).
Notes
2x2 in; head 1-1 3/8 in, FAM says top of head NOT hair; eyes 1 1/8-1 3/8 in from bottom (embassy). Glasses only with doctor statement.

Checked against the official US rules in November 2026. Rules change, so check that page before you apply. The exact wording behind each value is in the evidence file.

Tips for a photo that passes

  • Stand about 60 cm (2 ft) in front of a plain, light wall, facing a window or soft light.
  • Have someone else take it with the back camera from about 1.2 m (4 ft) away. Arm's-length selfies can distort your face.
  • Keep a neutral face with your mouth closed and both eyes open, looking straight at the lens.
  • Remove hats, headphones, glasses and anything covering your face.
  • Use the saved JPEG for online applications, or print the 4×6 in (10×15 cm) sheet at 100% scale and cut along the lines.
